name: worklog-to-notion
title: Worklog to Notion
description: Quickly append a time-sorted worklog entry to today's Notion work journal page.
author: v_allan

commands.name: add-worklog
commands.title: Add Worklog
commands.description: Insert a worklog entry into today's Notion journal page, sorted by start time.

preferences.name: notionApiKey
preferences.title: Notion API Key
preferences.description: Internal integration secret. The integration must be connected to the worklog database.

preferences.name: notionDatabaseId
preferences.title: Notion Database ID
preferences.description: ID of the worklog database (32 hex chars from the database URL).

preferences.name: notionDateProperty
preferences.title: Date Property Name
preferences.description: Database date property used to find today's page.

preferences.name: jiraBaseUrl
preferences.title: Jira Base URL
preferences.description: Used to look up ticket summaries.

preferences.name: jiraEmail
preferences.title: Jira Email
preferences.description: Atlassian account email. Needed only when filling in a Jira ticket.

preferences.name: jiraApiToken
preferences.title: Jira API Token
preferences.description: Atlassian API token. Needed only when filling in a Jira ticket.
